# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- Loan application rules: users must enter their linked card account number, which is shown as the payout destination. Interest rates are 0.9% daily for loans from ₦20k–₦50k, 0.9% daily for ₦50k–₦100k, and 0.88% daily for loans above ₦100k.
- Fixes must not modify existing personal categories or already-entered transactions unless explicitly requested.
